achievements.name: First Dive
achievements.detail: Leave Lifepod 5 and swim in the open water.

achievements.name: Radio Online
achievements.detail: Repair the lifepod radio so incoming signals can play.

achievements.name: Seabase
achievements.detail: Construct a habitat module and step inside through a hatch.

achievements.name: Seamoth
achievements.detail: Build a Seamoth at a Mobile Vehicle Bay and pilot it.

achievements.name: Prawn Suit
achievements.detail: Fabricate a Prawn Suit and walk it on the seafloor.

achievements.name: Cyclops
achievements.detail: Finish a Cyclops submarine and take the helm.

achievements.name: Board the Aurora
achievements.detail: Reach the crashed Aurora and explore the rooms inside its hull.

achievements.name: Deep Dive
achievements.detail: Descend to a depth of 500 meters or more.

achievements.name: Lost River
achievements.detail: Find an entrance and swim into the Lost River.

achievements.name: Lava Zone
achievements.detail: Pilot a vehicle down into the Inactive Lava Zone.

achievements.name: Alien Archive
achievements.detail: Enter a Precursor facility and download the data stored there.

achievements.name: Neptune Launch
achievements.detail: Build the Neptune escape rocket and launch it from the planet.
